messages:
frank_sales: FYI - NovaGen Bio is asking for a one-off promotional discount and extended terms while they switch PO owners. They want 25% off this quarter's Dedicated usage (~$72k run rate) and Net60 for the next 3 invoices. Can we approve?
leah_finance: Need details. Are they disputing a specific invoice or asking proactively for a concession?
frank_sales: Proactive. Pilot expanded faster than expected; procurement prefers Net60. They propose 25% off this quarter (~$18k) or convert to a fixed $18k credit.
omar_revops: Heads up - any credit >$10k needs comp ops sign-off and impacts MRR recognition/ARR. Also flagging tier-based discount policy limits.
jess_legal: Contractually we can offer a one-time promotional credit but we need an amendment or signed ack that this is non-recurring. Also want to avoid changing payment terms without amendment.
mike_fpna: Finance can approve up to $12,000 discretionary credits for strategic pilots. Anything above needs director approval. Net60 increases DSO; need AR signoff.
frank_sales: If we can't do $18k, would $12k + Net45 for two cycles be acceptable? Sales prefers not to waive too much margin.
leah_finance: I can approve $12k credit and Net45 for two invoices. Net60 is pushing the DSO too far given current AR backlog.
omar_revops: I'll create comp ops ticket CO-3921 to log the comp impact and handle commission adjustments.
jess_legal: Drafting the amendment wording: "Customer agrees to a one-time promotional credit of $12,000 applied to invoice INV-2026-0345. This credit is non-precedential and does not modify underlying subscription terms. Payment terms for next two invoices modified to Net45. Amendment effective upon customer's signed acknowledgement." I'll paste the draft here in a sec.
frank_sales: Perfect - I'll send to NovaGen and ask for a signed reply. Requesting it be returned within 48 hours so billing can apply.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0345 retrieved: 
```
Line 1: Redwood Dedicated - 12 GPUs x 720h = $72,000
Credits: none
Tax: $2,160
Total: $74,160
```
leah_finance: Once customer ack received, finance will issue credit memo CM-2026-052 for $12,000 and set payment term change for next two invoices.
omar_revops: Deal Desk entry: DDK-2026-112 created. Notes: NovaGen Bio - promotional credit $12k; Net45 x2; comp ops CO-3921.
mike_fpna: Approved (internal): $12,000 credit + Net45 x2 invoices. Please attach signed customer ack to the Deal Desk entry and tag AR.
frank_sales: Sending now. Will update thread when they reply. :pray:
jess_legal: Posted amendment copy: 
"We will apply a one-time credit of $12,000 to invoice INV-2026-0345. This credit is a goodwill gesture, non-recurring, and does not change the agreement except to modify payment terms to Net45 for the next two invoices. Customer must sign this acknowledgement"
frank_sales: NovaGen replied and signed: "Acknowledged and accepted." I'll upload their signed email to the Deal Desk.
billing-bot: Action queued: create CM-2026-052 for $12,000 and apply to INV-2026-0345 after CM creation. Set next two invoices to Net45 for customer_account: NOVAGEN-001.
leah_finance: Noted. Closing approval: $12k credit + Net45 x2. Documented in DDK-2026-112 and linked CO-3921.
frank_sales: Thanks everyone. If NovaGen pushes for more next quarter, will reopen here.
